[Slack #legal-review marcus Tue Jan 17 11:00 UTC 2026] IP indemnification: Everbridge MSA §9.1 has FOUR options (procure rights + modify + replace + refund). MSA v2.3 §9.2 has only THREE (missing procure rights). Flag this as a gap.

Confirmed. MSA v2.3 §9.2 lists: modify (a), replace (b), refund (c). The market benchmark (Everbridge §9.1, AWS §7.2) includes procure rights as a fourth option. This gap will be flagged as HIGH risk in the IP indemnification analysis.
